_doc: Frozen pixel baselines of the pre-theme app (Brutal / Elegant looks) captured once from commit a57b9dab with tool/theme-baseline (official + extension desktop) and tool/parity-ext/frozen-capture (extension phone / tablet / frame). Paths are relative to $PARITY_FROZEN_ROOT (default /mnt/data/theme-baseline); the first directory that holds <case id>.png wins. The baselines are deliverables: nothing in this repo deletes or rewrites them.
